query: Strikingly, we observed numerous de novo HFs throughout this nominally hairless skin in Gli1creERT2;R26Tom;Ptch1fl/fl mice. Crucially, nearly all these de novo HFs developed without attendant BCC-like lesions suggesting that de novo HF morphogenesis may indeed be successfully initiated without a tumor microenvironment; while the vismodegib experiment suggests persistence of such structures when the tumor microenvironment regresses in dorsal skin.
